title: Low-Concern Case — Mild Adjustment Difficulties
description: Presenting concerns are mild, safety signals absent, strong support system

conversation.content: I recently moved to a new city for work and I'm finding it harder than expected to settle in. I feel a bit isolated.
How long have you been in the new city?
About four months. The job is going well, I enjoy it. But I miss my friends and family.
How has the isolation been affecting you day to day?
I feel a bit lonely in the evenings and weekends. During work I'm fine. I've been cooking more which helps.
How about sleep and general wellbeing?
Sleep is good — about 7-8 hours. Eating well. Energy is fine. No real complaints there.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
No, not at all. I'm fundamentally okay. Just a bit homesick I think.
Do you have support you can access — friends or family, even remotely?
Yes. I call my parents weekly and I have a group of close friends I stay in touch with. I'm also starting to meet people at work.
What are you hoping to get from speaking with someone?
Just some strategies to build connections more quickly and manage the adjustment better. I don't think it's anything serious.
